catalyst_observation.source_statement: FDA placed the KOMET-001 Phase 1b study of KO-539 (ziftomenib) in relapsed/refractory AML on a partial clinical hold following a Grade 5 serious adverse event (patient death) potentially associated with differentiation syndrome. The company suspended guidance on Phase 1b enrollment completion and Phase 2 dose determination pending resolution - a standalone, single-issue negative disclosure (no bundled positive news, unlike the rejected Beam Therapeutics BEAM-201 clinical-hold disclosure, which was buried inside a broadly positive Q2 earnings release headlined by a $1.2B cash position).
